Tests cover each rule.

tasks.title: T-5 Listing detail pages emit the internal-entry event when arriving from a same-origin page
tasks.description:
Web side of T-075: on accommodation/venue/experience/partner detail pages, when document.referrer is same-origin, send the T-075 catalog event once per page load via the Umami tracker, with tag=<entityId>. Consent rules as for the other web events. Tests: emitted on same-origin referrer, not on external/empty referrer.

REVIEW NOTES 2026-11-16: send with the function form umami.track((p) => ({...p, name: AnalyticsEvents.listingInternalEntry, data, tag: entityId})) so the tag never depends on the script attribute (umami.track({...}) object form drops the tag). The tracker script is defer: wait/queue until window.umami exists. G20 is satisfied by the api reader, so it will NOT catch a missing emitter: this task MUST include a test asserting the emission. Side effect: any custom event removes the visit from Umami bounce counting.
